fields.title: Recipient Email
fields.help_text: Where submissions are delivered. Defaults to the site administration email.

fields.title: Subject Prefix
fields.help_text: Prepended to the subject of every notification email.

fields.title: Store submissions
fields.help_text: Keep a copy in the database as well as emailing it. Turn this off if you would rather not retain personal data.

fields.title: Honeypot field
fields.help_text: Adds a hidden field that real people never fill in. Cheap, and invisible to visitors.

fields.title: Minimum time to complete (seconds)
fields.help_text: Reject submissions sent faster than this. Set to 0 to disable the check.

sections.title: Google reCAPTCHA v2
sections.description: Optional. Register this site at google.com/recaptcha/admin/create — choose reCAPTCHA v2 with the "I'm not a robot" tick box and add the site's domain — then paste the two keys below. Keys you already have are listed at google.com/recaptcha/admin. Fill both in to offer reCAPTCHA as a per-form option; leave them blank and the option stays hidden, since it could not work anyway.

fields.title: Site Key
fields.help_text: The Site Key from the reCAPTCHA console. It is public and appears in the page, so it does not need protecting.

fields.title: Secret Key
fields.help_text: The Secret Key from the same screen. Kept server-side and never rendered into a page — treat it like a password.
